## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Joey Downey_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "Used to Love this App so much, But i either got a bug that makes me not be able to chat the the bots at all. or I am being forced to pay for a subscription. this App was great for its Free tier, and its awsome story capibility. now the free parts gone and i have to find a replacement untill hopefully they go back to the Ads (Edit i also hate that now their trying to make you have a persona, i like choosing my character without having to make an entire mini account for it)"
            2. _Anastassia Kats_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "App was pretty good for a while, I personally don't use up all the 180 message limit they have, so it hasn't been an issue (though obviously this is a by person experiance). What ruined it completely is the update that limited visible messages to those that were sent within 14 days of the last conversation, and a new update that limited the bots you could use to four. So many RP's I had are lost now and I've lost any interest in the app, as I'm sure other have."
            3. _April H_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "as long as you can afford the subscription the app is good. if you can't then the ads get aggravating especially being at the top of chat. it makes it to where you can not see what you type after a few lines. here lately, I can chat for a few paragraphs then it stop responding. have to close app and restart it. a few more paragraphs then it quits responding. have to close and restart again. very annoying. if they would get rid of ads at the top of messages then it would be ok. need to fix bugs."
